jobs.occupation: Business Controller, Netcompany DK FP&A Team
jobs.description:
Stillingsbeskrivelse

We are looking for a driven Business Controller with a strong motivation for FP&A to join Netcompany DK. You are either a recent graduate or have 1–3 years of experience, and you will play a central role in ensuring timely and accurate management reporting, as well as in-depth analyses of our business and financial KPIs. You will become part of a dynamic team where collaboration across departments and with different stakeholders is a natural part of everyday life.

Your responsibilities

You will become part of a well-functioning and collaborative team where you will have plenty of opportunities to share ideas, learn from colleagues, and grow professionally. Working closely with the Head of Finance NBS and DK, you will take ownership of key aspects of the monthly financial reporting to management. This includes following up on our business areas and preparing presentations.

In addition to being responsible for your own areas, you will have a broad range of stakeholders, where collaboration with the other Shared Services departments in the business is an important part of the role. The position will give you unique insight into the financial value drivers of the company and an understanding of the financial parameters that drive a business.

Your responsibilites will typically include:

• Conducting business analyses

• Comment on monthly reports for your areas of responsibility

• Contributing to the continuous improvement of the monthly reporting process

• Participating with your own areas of responsibility in the development of our system structure

• Actively participating in the budgeting and forecasting processes

About you

As a person, you are motivated by working with both complex and operational tasks, and you possess the ability to communicate across the organization. You have a proactive mindset and strong business acumen, combined with excellent analytical skills. You take initiative, identify opportunities for improvement, and are motivated by contributing to the development of the organization. With a keen eye for detail and a strong focus on quality, you take pride in delivering accurate results and meeting deadlines in a structured and reliable manner.

To succeed in this role, you:

• Are newly graduated or at the beginning of your career within a Cand.Merc. (Master of Science in Business and Economics), for example Cand.Merc.Fir, Cand.Merc.Asc, Cand.Merc.Aef., or similar education.

• Have experience working in Excel and processing large volumes of data.

• Are initiative-taking and are keen to contribute to improving and developing processes. At the same time, you have an eye for detail and work in a structured manner.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

Send us your application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance. #LI-SA1

jobs.occupation: Senior Associate, Group Investments & Financing
jobs.description:
_Do you want to join a global leader in renewable energy infrastructure investment? Do you thrive with investment analysis, structured problem-solving, and translating complex analyses into strategic decisions? Then Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners (CIP) is the perfect place for you. We are currently looking for a Senior Associate to join our Group Investments and Financing team.

_**The team

**The Group Investments and Financing team is responsible for CIP Holding's balance sheet investment activities and capital allocation priorities, providing decision support to the CFO, CIP management, and CIP's owners. We work as a closely integrated team, delivering high-quality investment analyses and recommendations in collaboration with the responsible Partner and CFO as well as stakeholders across CIP. Our work supports major investment decisions and plays an important role in shaping CIP's long-term growth and strategic direction.

**The role

**As our new Senior Associate, you will help support CIP Holding's investment activities from analysis through to execution. This is an investment-focused role that combines well-developed analytical and strategic capabilities with practical project management and stakeholder engagement. You will work closely with the responsible Partner, the CFO, and colleagues across CIP, with direct exposure to senior stakeholders and strategic investment decisions.

You will join a highly motivated environment of talented colleagues with backgrounds from investment banking, private equity, and strategy consulting. The role offers significant responsibility early on and great opportunities for professional development.

You will thrive in a busy environment, balancing multiple priorities while consistently delivering high-quality work.

**Responsibilities will consist of, but are not limited to:

**

• Support CIP Holding's investments and strategic projects across CIP-managed funds, affiliated GPs, and new CIP companies

• Contribute to the development and refinement of the CIP Holding investment strategy, including capital allocation frameworks and long-term balance sheet planning

• Support the evaluation and execution of tactical allocation decisions, including analysis of investment and divestment opportunities

• Conduct investment analysis, valuation modelling, market assessments, and due diligence on new opportunities

• Support the negotiation of commercial and legal terms with funds, counterparties, and co-investors, alongside the responsible Partner and legal teams

• Manage project timelines, workstreams, and stakeholders across multiple parallel initiatives, ensuring clear ownership and follow-through

• Prepare investment recommendations, decision materials, and presentations for senior stakeholders and the Board

• Structure complex problems and perform thorough analysis to support strategic decision-making

• Collaborate across finance, legal, business development, and investor relations to support transaction execution and strategic initiatives

• Support ad hoc analyses, board materials, and special projects for the Partners and senior team members

**You

**We are looking for a motivated and collaborative professional with a Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related discipline, combined with approximately 2-4 years of relevant experience from investment banking, private equity, management consulting, corporate finance, or a similar analytical environment.

CIP offers an international, intellectually stimulating, and high-performance environment. We are looking for a motivated, detail-oriented, and analytical professional who is focused on developing themselves within strategic investments and capital allocation.

**Key qualifications include:

**

• Strong financial and strategic acumen, with solid valuation, investment analysis, and financial modelling skills

• Experience supporting transaction processes, due diligence, and investment-related analyses

• Ability to structure complex problems and evaluate opportunities and risks across a range of scenarios, with solid numerical skills and attention to detail

• Skilled in project management, with experience overseeing processes, bringing stakeholders together, and tracking multiple workstreams

• Experience with, or interest in, negotiating commercial and legal terms

• Advanced Excel and PowerPoint proficiency, with the ability to produce high-quality decision materials

• Interest in fund structures, GP/LP dynamics, and infrastructure or renewable energy investments is an advantage

• A proactive and structured approach, with ownership of deliverables and the motivation to move projects forward

• Skilled at building productive relationships and collaborating across teams and functions

• Excellent written and verbal English skills

**The process

**Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

**Building value that matters

**Founded in 2012, Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners P/S (CIP) today is the world’s largest dedicated fund manager within greenfield renewable energy investments and a global leader in offshore wind. To date, CIP has developed and constructed more than +50 greenfield renewable projects around the world. CIP is developing a greenfield project portfolio of ~160GW total, and ~16 GW is in operation or under construction. CIP manages 13 funds and has to date raised approximately EUR ~35 billion for investments in energy and associated infrastructure from more than ~200 international institutional investors.

CIP has a multinational team of ~500 full-time employees with extensive experience and knowledge within the fields of renewable energy project development and regulated infrastructure. In addition, CIP has a broad range of competencies within corporate finance, mergers & acquisitions, engineering, construction, project development, and project management.

CIP has built a prominent investment team capable of originating proprietary investment opportunities and executing projects and investments based on the team’s industrial background, large industrial network, and extensive experience in structuring, executing, and managing investments within energy infrastructure. Headquartered in Copenhagen, CIP also operates from key locations across the globe, including offices in Hamburg, Munich, London, Utrecht, New York, Tokyo, Melbourne, Luxembourg, Kuala Lumpur, Seoul and Singapore. In addition, CIP has 17 local project offices globally.

For more information, visit www.cip.com.

jobs.occupation: PKPD Senior Principal Scientist
jobs.description:
Department: DMPK and Modelling Sciences

Location: [Måløv]

Your impact begins here

As a Pharmacokinetics and Pharmacodynamics (PKPD) Senior Principal Scientist, you will shape how translational modelling supports decisions across drug discovery and development. You will set direction for PKPD strategies, connect preclinical evidence with human safety and efficacy, and help interdisciplinary teams progress a diverse research portfolio. Your scientific leadership will strengthen project decisions from early research through clinical development and regulatory submission.

What you’ll bring

You bring deep expertise in translational science and mathematical modelling, together with the judgement to turn complex evidence into clear recommendations. You communicate effectively across disciplines, work independently and help colleagues solve scientific challenges.

• A PhD in pharmaceutical, medical, physical, mathematical or engineering sciences, or another relevant discipline, combined with substantial pharmaceutical industry experience.

• Ideally, at least ten years of relevant experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.

• Strong knowledge and hands-on experience in PKPD, quantitative systems pharmacology and/or physiologically based pharmacokinetic modelling.

• Experience developing mechanistic models, or combinations of mechanistic and empirical models, to represent biological or other natural processes.

• Practical experience with pharmacokinetic and modelling software such as Phoenix WinNonlin/NLME, NONMEM or an equivalent platform, and with analytical tools such as R, Python or MATLAB.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence decisions and collaborate across scientific disciplines.

Useful, but not essential: Experience with machine-learning workflows, managing external service providers, or supporting due diligence within physiologically based pharmacokinetic and pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic modelling.

What you’ll do

• Set the direction for translational PKPD screening and mechanistic modelling across different molecular formats, working with research, non-clinical and clinical stakeholders.

• Design preclinical PKPD/pharmacodynamic studies, interpret the results and communicate conclusions that support project decisions.

• Build mathematical models and run simulations of human PKPD using in-house in vitro and animal data, together with relevant literature.

• Guide project teams on preclinical study design, dose setting for toxicity studies, first-in-human dose selection and clinical trial design.

• Contribute scientific input to regulatory interactions and documents, including Investigational New Drug applications, Investigational Medicinal Product Dossiers and New Drug Applications.

• Advance scientific capabilities in mechanistic modelling and PKPD, solve complex problems and mentor fellow scientists.

Who you’ll work with

You will join one of two closely connected PKPD teams within DMPK and Modelling Sciences. Together, the teams advance the use of quantitative systems pharmacology, physiologically based pharmacokinetic modelling and PKPD modelling across the research and development value chain.

Your closest collaborators will include in vivo pharmacologists, in vitro biologists, clinical modelling scientists, toxicologists, clinicians and regulatory affairs specialists. The area is part of Global Research within Research & Development and works with global discovery and development colleagues, project teams and external partners.

What you can expect here

You can expect a scientifically ambitious environment where knowledge-sharing and collaboration are part of the everyday work. You will have room to build your scientific and personal capabilities while contributing expertise that informs preclinical studies, first-in-human trials, clinical development and regulatory submissions. The role offers broad exposure across therapeutic areas and across the development pathway, from early research to submission.

Salary:

For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 847,000 to 1,245,100 (DK), corresponding to the level of the position. The confirmed JL9 pay table lists these as the annual minimum and maximum values, but the source does not state the currency explicitly.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy. The salary and benefits wording follows the approved pay-transparency section in Job Ad Guidelines.

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to use translational modelling to strengthen decisions across research and development, apply for the PKPD Senior Principal Scientist role by 8**. November 2026.** Applications will be assessed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

For further information, please contact Line Hollesen Schefe, Manager, Non-clinical PKPD and PBPK, at +45 3077 6009.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

jobs.occupation: Project manager for international research projects
jobs.description:
Are you enthusiastic about making a difference to large societal challenges such as green transition of energy, materials and food systems?

Do you have experience with research project management, funding administration and project development? 

Do you know your way around a Horizon Europe project and do you enjoy being the person who keeps a large international consortium on track?

Do you thrive in a dynamic working environment, with multiple external and internal stakeholders?

Then we might be looking for you!

At the Department of Biological and Chemical Engineering at Aarhus University, we are busy conducting research on a broad range of topics related to green transition, sustainability and health. Our portfolio of EU-funded projects is growing, and we are therefore looking for an experienced EU project manager with international experience who can drive development and execution of international projects in close collaboration with researchers, external partners and the department’s Partnerships and External Relations team.

Expected starting date and duration
The position is a two-year fixed-term position starting on 1 January 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

Job descripton
At Department of Biological and Chemical Engineering, we are experiencing an increase in externally funded, international research and innovation projects. As project manager you will play a key role in managing and coordinating the department’s participation in such projects, in particular large Horizon Europe projects with multiple partners, where our department has a leading role 

Working closely with the scientific coordinator, you will:

• Act as the day-to-day operational point of contact for the consortium. 
• Drive the coordination machinery: Track deliverables, milestones and risks, chase and quality-assure partner contributions.
• Prepare periodic/final reporting, and coordinate financial reporting with partners and with the administrative and financial experts in AU’s central research support office.
• Plan and run consortium, General Assembly and review meetings: Agendas, minutes and follow-up on decisions.
• Maintain the Consortium Agreement and support obligations on data management, ethics, dissemination, exploitation and communication.
In addition to this, you will:

• Support the department’s wider portfolio of international projects, being work package or task manager where relevant.
• Provide guidance and support to the development of new European grant proposals and the building of new consortia.
• Participate in and help organise externally oriented activities and events.
• Help shape the department’s way of working around externally funded projects, so that good practice is developed and shared.
The role is vested in the department’s Partnerships and External Relations team. The team supports our researchers within multiple aspects of externally funded research collaborations - from strategy development, visibility, partnership and project development to execution of complex projects. We are continuously developing our way of working to support increased activity level and creation of impact.

Qualifications
We are looking for someone who combines hands-on experience of EU project execution with the ability to work comfortably alongside researchers in a technical field.

Technical qualifications:

• Academic degree in a relevant field (e.g., technical sciences, international relations etc.).
• Experience with the day-to-day management of Horizon Europe or Horizon 2020 projects; including reporting, deliverable and milestone tracking.
• Experience of working with international research consortia and of coordinating contributions from partners in several countries.
• The ability to engage with technical content well enough to quality-assure deliverables and to discuss the work with researchers on their own terms.
Qualifications we regard as an advantage:

• Experience from the coordinator side of an EU project, rather than as a beneficiary partner only.
• Experience with proposal development, grant writing and consortium building.
• Familiarity with research areas related to the green transition; for example bioresources, biotechnology, chemical or environmental engineering.
• Familiarity with EU financial rules, cost eligibility and audit requirements.
Personal qualifications:

• Excellent communication skills, with fluency in English. Knowledge of Danish is an advantage.
• Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities effectively
• Service-minded attitude, flexibility, and a collaborative approach to working in a team
• Ability to travel internationally as needed (few times per year). 
Who we are
At the Department of Biological and Chemical Engineering we focus on living systems, the biology of organisms, efficient production, and transformation of chemicals, materials and energy. We translate knowledge within biotechnology, food technology, environmental technology, chemical engineering, industrial biotechnology, medical biotechnology and electrochemical engineering etc. more into new technologies and value-creating solutions that can also be used in the business community.

Many of our research and development activities are based on companies' specific innovation needs or specialist application areas. Close collaboration with the public sector and private businesses ensures that the knowledge and technology generated in the department's research environments has a clear anchoring in reality and benefits the surrounding society. We also provide research-based public sector consultancy and advice on technology in agriculture and food.

At the department, we educate BEng, BSc and MSc graduates in engineering for Danish society.

Read more about the department and sections here:
https://bce.au.dk/en/research/key-areas-in-research-and-development

Department of Biological and Chemical Engineering offers:

• Opportunity to contribute to solutions of crucial importance to society and industry
• The possibility of being part of a dynamic research environment in rapid development
• An exciting, cross-disciplinary environment with strong external partnerships with industrial and academic partners in Denmark and abroad
• A workplace characterized by professionalism, trust and healthy work-life balance
Place of work and area of employment 
The place of work Gustav Wieds Vej 10D, 8000 Aarhus, Denmark and the area of employment is Aarhus University, Department of Biological and Chemical Engineering.

Contact information
For further information, please contact: Deputy head of department, Thomas Lundgaard, +45 29 16 31 35 / thomas.lundgaard@bce.au.dk

Application deadline
9 November 2026.

Formalities and salary range
You will be employed as an academic staff member at basic salary grades 4–8. For the right candidate, there will be an opportunity to be appointed as a Special Consultant, with remuneration in accordance with Appendix 4 of the collective agreement.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

jobs.occupation: Senior Software Engineer, Online
jobs.description:
About the job

Flatpay has become one of the fastest-growing payment companies by helping merchants accept payments in-store. Now we're taking the next step.

Online is one of Flatpay's newest and most strategic engineering domains. We're building the products and platforms that enable merchants to accept payments online and grow their businesses in the digital economy. As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll play a key role in defining the technical direction of Flatpay's online platform and helping establish the technical and architectural foundations that will support the next phase of Flatpay's growth.

This is a unique opportunity to join at an early stage. While Flatpay already serves merchants at scale, our online platform is still in its early stages. You'll have the opportunity to help launch new solutions, shape how the platform evolves as adoption grows, and learn directly from customers along the way.

If you enjoy building products from the ground up, working close to customers, and seeing your work evolve from first launch to large-scale adoption, you'll have the opportunity to make a significant impact in a domain that will play an important role in Flatpay's future growth.

What you'll do

• 
Design and build scalable systems that power online payments and commerce experiences

• 
Lead feature and platform initiatives involving multiple engineers, driving delivery from discovery through production

• 
Take ownership of features from design and implementation through deployment and maintenance

• 
Drive architectural decisions and long-term technical improvements

•

• 
Improve reliability, observability, performance, and security across the platform

•

•

•

Who you are

• 
7+ years of professional software engineering experience

•

• 
Demonstrated ability to lead technical projects involving multiple engineers and influence architectural decisions

• 
Experience building scalable backend platforms and APIs

• 
Comfortable navigating ambiguity and helping shape new products and systems

• 
Strong communication and collaboration skills

• 
Experience within payments, fintech, e-commerce, SaaS, or high-scale transaction systems is a plus

Observability & Monitoring

Why Flatpay?

As part of our team, you'll join 2,000+ passionate Flatpayers dedicated to shaping the future of payments.

You'll help build a strategic new business area from the ground up, working on products that directly connect merchants and consumers while shaping the future of online payments at Flatpay.

We offer an inclusive environment where engineers are trusted with ownership and encouraged to make an impact.

Our engineering teams work together from our Copenhagen office. We believe that close collaboration, quick feedback loops, and solving problems side-by-side help us build better products, move faster, and create a stronger engineering culture.

We also provide plenty of perks including free slush ice, an on-site gym, a fully equipped gamer room, and much more.

If you're ready to help build and scale the future of payments, we'd love to hear from you.

Perks and benefits

This job comes with several perks and benefits

Near public transit

Working at

Flatpay

WHAT IS FLATPAY? At Flatpay, we believe that merchants deserve a payment solution that is easy to understand, affordable, and free from hidden fees. That's why we offer a straightforward pricing model with no setup fees for terminals, no subscription fees, and a flat rate for all card types. It's a breath of fresh air compared to the complicated and confusing pricing structures of our competitors.  What sets Flatpay apart is our dedication. We continuously strive to stay ahead of the curve, adapting our solutions to meet our client's evolving needs. Ready to be part of something extraordinary? WHAT's THE CULTURE LIKE? Flatpay is a fast-moving, performance-driven environment where people are trusted to take ownership from day one. We value initiative, resilience, and a strong work ethic. Our teams are collaborative and supportive, but we also set clear expectations and hold ourselves accountable to results.  As a growing business, things move quickly. That means you’ll have the opportunity to take on real responsibility early, contribute ideas, and see the impact of your work directly. It also means being comfortable with change, solving problems as they arise, and continuously improving how we operate.  We’re best suited to people who are motivated by challenge, enjoy working towards clear goals, and want to develop in a commercial, high-energy environment. WHY CHOOSE FLATPAY? Flatpay offers the opportunity to take real ownership, develop valuable skills, and grow your career in a fast-moving, ambitious company where performance and initiative are recognised.

jobs.occupation: Warehouse operative for the switchboard workshop in Esbjerg
jobs.description:
We are stepping up in Esbjerg — we are looking for a warehouse operative for our new switchboard workshop.

About the position

The expansion of our Tech Centre Esbjerg continues: we are now opening a switchboard workshop, and it needs a warehouse operative to manage the flow of goods. Components, cables and materials come in through the gate, and at the other end products must go out to installation and service jobs. Everything passes through the warehouse — and it will be your job to keep the flow running.

Your responsibilities

• Receiving goods, checking them against the delivery note and registering them in the system

• Supplying the panel builders with components, cables and materials

• Picking materials for panel building, installation and service jobs

• Packing and preparing shipments for installation sites and service vans

• Keeping stock levels up to date and flagging in good time when something is running low

• Keeping shelving, labelling and walkways in order

We expect you to

• have warehouse experience — knowledge of electrical or industrial components is a plus

• have an overview and a sense of order, even when the workshop is busy

• be reliable and take responsibility

• be willing to take on general tasks as they arise

• hold a driving licence for cars (category B).

We offer

• A central role in the switchboard workshop — your work keeps production running

• Close day-to-day collaboration with panel builders, fitters and the service department

• Colleagues who help each other, and short lines to management

jobs.occupation: Student Assistant in Support & Service Delivery
jobs.description:
About Cardlay:

Cardlay is a Danish FinTech company founded with a clear purpose: We want to deliver new standards for fast and efficient spend management for corporations on a global scale. We are a strategic partner to banks, card issuers, processors, and financial institutions. Our mission is to empower card issuers with cutting-edge spend management solutions, streamlining corporate clients' financial operations with ease.

Our core team comprises hand-picked specialists dedicated to technical and business development excellence.

Position overview:

We're looking for a serviceminded, curious student assistant to join our Support & Service Delivery team. You'll make sure our customers and partners get fast, competent help. You'll get thorough onboarding and take on more responsibility as you get to know our platform.

What you'll be doing:

• Handle first-line support by answering questions from customers and partners by email, chat and phone.
• Support second-line cases by troubleshooting more complex issues together with the team and our technical department.
• Create and maintain help articles, guides and FAQs so customers can find answers on their own.
• Contribute to ad hoc tasks within support, service delivery and self-service.
What we're looking for:

• Enrolled in a higher education programme, ideally in IT, business, communication or a related field.
• Outgoing and confident talking to customers and partners, whether by phone, chat or email.
• Strong written and spoken communication skills in English and a Nordic language, with a friendly, clear way of explaining things to customers and partners.
• Hands-on experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude, and an interest in how AI can improve support and self-service.
• Tech-savvy and quick to learn new systems, with a genuine curiosity about how our product works.
• A logical, technical mindset and comfort with troubleshooting alongside customers. No coding required.
• Structured and reliable. You keep track of your cases, follow up on them and take ownership.
• Bonus: Experience with customer service, support tools (e.g. Zendesk & Jira)
What you'll get:

• A flexible student job that fits around your studies and exam periods, at approx. 10-15 hours per week.
• Hands-on experience in support, SaaS and fintech.
• Thorough onboarding and helpful, experienced colleagues.
• A strong addition to your CV and valuable experience in the fintech industry.
We want all our team members to feel valued every day. Hit apply, even if you don't tick all the boxes. We see people as the fundamental pillar of our success, so we invest in the personal growth and skill development of everyone. We combine an innovative, entrepreneurial atmosphere with a high level of professionalism and a culture where everyone takes ownership of their work.

We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply regardless of race/ethnicity, religion, nationality, gender, sex, socio-economic status, culture or belief.

Go ahead and hit "apply" and upload your résumé, application and other relevant information through our HR system.

Any questions about the position can be directed to our Support and Service Delivery Manager:

Stine Mylting, Telephone: +45 23626911

Application deadline: As soon as possible.

jobs.occupation: Development Team Lead with People Management responsibility
jobs.description:
At Dalux, we build mission-critical software used by construction projects in more than 140 countries. Our product teams own real impact - from idea to deployment - and we are now looking for a Team Lead who can combine technical credibility with strong people leadership.

As Team Lead, you are responsible for a dedicated software development team working on our product. Besides a Team Lead and a Tech Lead, each team consists of software developers (6 to 12 people total), as well as an associated Product Manager and a Product Designer.

This role combines your flair for planning and execution with people management; in other words, you will be accountable for your team’s delivery as well as its well-being and working culture.

The role has three essential parts:

• Product & Delivery Ownership

Together with the Product Manager and Product Designer, you form the core leadership of your product team. We call this the Product Trio.

Your tasks:

• Ensure strong collaboration as part of the Product Trio

• Balance feasibility with value and usability

• Drive clarity in scope, priorities, and technical direction

• Ensure realistic planning, clear commitments, and predictable high-quality delivery

• Continuous Improvement & Coordination

As a leader in Dalux Development, you contribute to strengthening our engineering culture and ways of working.

Your tasks:

• Ensure continuous improvement of your team’s processes and developer experience

• Contribute to or drive cross-team feature initiatives when relevant

• Help scale our organization while maintaining quality and culture by engaging in leadership forums, guilds, and initiatives.

• People Management

You ensure your developers are motivated, engaged, and supported in their professional growth.

Your tasks:

• Support continuous growth through sparring, mentoring, and career development discussions.

• Conduct regular 1–1s and maintain a strong team atmosphere through servant leadership and with a strong emphasis on coaching.

• Conduct recruitment interviews, assess optimal team placement, and finalize employment contracts.

• Handle performance improvement and yearly salary adjustments.

**About You

**

• You have a record of taking responsibility — either technical or people leadership

• You are a structured person who can balance delivery pressure with long-term quality

• You have the skill to lead developers and the motivation to help them grow

• You have a university degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or similar

• You have a strong background in software development (experience in C#/.NET, Angular, AWS or similar technologies is a plus)

• You understand Agile Software Development and empowered product teams

**About Dalux

**Dalux is a Danish software company founded in 2005 by Ph.D. Bent Dalgaard and Torben Dalgaard. Our products are designed to make the construction industry smarter and more efficient. We are more than 300 software developers in-house – and continue to grow.

Using our own 3D BIM technology, Dalux develops user-friendly digital tools that are used in more than 140 countries worldwide. We are passionate about modern technology and proud to be first movers in applying new technologies - all developed entirely in-house at Dalux.

jobs.occupation: Senior Director, IT & Digital
jobs.description:
Faerch A/S

Faerch is a leading supplier of circular, rigid food packaging with integrated recycling capabilities. With more than 5,000 employees across Europe and the U.S., Faerch serves food manufacturers, food service providers, and retailers globally through a network of state-of-the-art production facilities.

The company is owned by A.P. Moller Holding and is driven by a clear purpose: to accelerate the transition toward a circular economy in food packaging.

With sustainability at the core of its strategy, Faerch develops innovative packaging solutions designed for recyclability and high levels of post-consumer recycled content. The company is currently undergoing a transformation to strengthen integration, customer focus and operational excellence, captured in its strategic ambition, “Ignite our potential”.

Read more at: www.faerch.com

Senior Director, IT & Digital

Faerch is looking for a Senior Director, IT & Digital to lead and further develop the global IT & Digital function and support the company’s continued digital transformation.

In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring a scalable, secure, and business-oriented foundation that supports operational efficiency, data security, and customer satisfaction through cutting-edge technology and digital solutions.

A key leadership role in Faerch’s digital transformation

In this role, you will be responsible for the continued professionalization of Faerch’s global IT function, with a strong focus on cybersecurity, infrastructure stability, uptime, data integrity and security, governance, and operational excellence.

You will lead an organization of ~55 employees located across several European markets, including a management team of three direct reports, while also being responsible for the IT budget ownership and spend management across the function. In addition, you will report directly to the Global CFO and be given the mandate to position Global IT & Digital as a strategic business partner to support the execution of the new strategy.

A key priority in this regard will be to accelerate the roll-out of M3 Cloud across Faerch’s factories and ensure that the ERP programme is managed, structured, and implemented as a global transformation. At the same time, you will be responsible for ensuring stable operations, high uptime, strong cyber security, and a simplified application landscape.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Leading the transition of the ERP system from a project-based implementation to a structured global programme in close collaboration with key functional leaders.

• Ensuring high operational reliability across business-critical systems and production environments.

• Strengthening maturity and governance within cyber security across the global IT landscape.

• Defining and maturing Faerch’s AI and digital agenda, including relevant use cases across the organization.

• Maintaining a responsive and efficient service desk that effectively addresses user needs and resolves technical issues promptly.

• Leading and motivating the IT organization, ensuring strong engagement, clear direction, and effective collaboration across disciplines and locations.

• Strengthening Global IT as a trusted business partner through alignment with stakeholders, and digital solutions that support operational and commercial priorities.

Who are you?

We are looking for an experienced IT leader who can strike a balance between strategic transformation and stable day-to-day operations. You bring a solid technical foundation and a proven track record of leading complex digital initiatives in international organizations – ideally from manufacturing companies or other operationally intensive environments with multiple sites and a high reliance on stable systems.

You have experience leading geographically dispersed digital teams across a range of disciplines and thrive in a role that involves setting the direction, creating structure, and ensuring progress. At the same time, you have a strong business acumen that enables you to translate business needs into effective solutions and value-creating initiatives. Furthermore, you are able to translate complex technological agendas into clear priorities that both specialists, managers, and senior stakeholders can understand and act upon.

Personally, you are a visionary and results-oriented individual with a genuine passion for technology, innovation and business impact. You are able to constructively challenge existing working methods with a view to driving improvements. As a leader, you are collaborative, build trust easily, and know how to foster engagement in daily operations.

If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Research Consultant Simone Svenningsen on tel. 2616 3704.

Please note that we only need your CV when you apply for the position. Your enquiry will be treated confidentially and will not be passed on without your consent.

jobs.occupation: Product Designer
jobs.description:
It’s an exciting time to join Tactile. We're a diverse team of storytellers, puzzle enthusiasts, and casual mobile game creators. Our story began in 2008 in the heart of beautiful Copenhagen, and since then, we have experienced continuous growth, establishing ourselves as one of the largest gaming companies in Denmark. In more recent years, we have been scaling fast, in large part thanks to the success of a little game called Lily’s Garden. Now we’re on a mission to solidify our position as one of the leaders in creating out-of-the-ordinary casual puzzle games.

With more than 350 talented individuals, we are a mix of over 50 nationalities and 43% women. We truly appreciate the richness of different experiences and perspectives that Tactilers bring to the game. This is why we foster a lean organisational culture, in which each individual is encouraged to take responsibility, be open, and grow in their own way. We pride ourselves on cultivating a studio environment that avoids crunch, fosters your skills regardless of your discipline, and provides a space for you to be creative alongside other passionate and invested storytellers.

**🚀 Your Role & Impact

**We're currently growing our Core team and are on the lookout for another Product Designer to join our team of talented engineers.

The Core team builds the internal tools behind Tactile own LiveOps, Marketing and Data operations, the backbone of our studio. We're looking for a second Product Designer to join Joy and our engineers in designing business-critical tools that every team at Tactile depends on.

**This role is based in our Copenhagen office.

****How We Design

**

• Our tools are data-heavy: dashboards, large tables, complex filters, multi-step workflows. Static mockups can't show how they behave with real data, so we prototype first, in code. We use Claude Code and agentic workflows to build working prototypes, and those prototypes are what we hand off to developers. Figma is still where we sketch and brainstorm

• AI amplifies our design. It doesn't do design for us. It lets us take on complex workflows that used to get skipped because they took too much effort

• Quality is not up for debate. We know what good looks like, and we don't ship slop

• Our product design philosophies are inspired by Vercel, Linear and GitHub

This is roughly how we work today. It isn't strict, and we're open to what you bring. Here's a talk that captures our thinking.

Okay, let’s get a little bit more specific. Here’s what you’ll be doing on the day-to-day:

• Research, design and prototype interfaces for our internal tools, then hand working prototypes off to developers

• Work with your team who use our tools to simplify their workflows

• Use AI to explore, iterate and prototype efficiently, while you stay responsible for every design decision and not outsource creative thinking.

• Evolve and contribute to our design system and processes

• We don't have a big UX team, and that's on purpose. You'll work every day with Product Managers, Frontend and Backend engineers, Artists, Game Programmers. We believe good products come from working across disciplines, so we care about the end product, not design operations

**What We’re Looking For

**

• Hands-on experience with technical B2B products: dashboards, tables, filters, dense interfaces

• You care more about the end product than about design process, and you thrive working across disciplines

• Comfortable contributing directly to projects via PRs to improve designs or UX without waiting for programmers to implement them

• Experience in designing with Claude Code or similar agentic tools

• Real openness to agentic workflows, without an "AI produces slop" mindset

• Comfort prototyping in code, or a strong drive to learn

• A sharp eye for high design craft, quality, and candour when something isn't good enough

**You'll Make Us Extra Excited If You Also Have

**

• Experience in using Figma/Figma Make or similar design tools

• Programmer background, comfortable diving into fronted code if necessary

• Know-how of shadcn, Untitled UI or similar SaaS UI libraries

**What’s in it for you?

**🌆 Beautiful office space with probably the best view in Copenhagen

🩺 Pension and private health insurance

💻 A chance to work with the latest tools and technology

📚 Opportunities for individual growth with development talks as well as workshops, books and courses

🌮 Daily, healthy organic breakfast and lunch prepared by our professional chefs in-house

🥳 Social activities, including game nights, book club, Friday bar and more

🔍 Free Danish lessons with our in-house Danish teacher

**Our interview process

**Submit your application via the fill-in form at the top of this page. This is the easiest and fastest way to get in touch with our recruiters. We foster an inclusive culture and accessible workplace and want to make sure we provide everyone with the same opportunities for success. This is why we encourage you to apply regardless of your gender, sexuality, age, nationality, neurodiversity or disability. We review applications based on competencies and experience, so please do tell us about your favorite projects and technologies.

After we review your application, you can expect to go through the following conversations:

☕ Introductory coffee chat, primarily to ensure that we’re aligned on the scope of the role and that all of your questions are answered.

🧪 In person technical interview (mix of design whiteboarding and designing with AI) with Joy, your future product design colleague, and Gab, Core Team Lead.

💜 The final conversation will be with your future team, to discuss if you’re aligned on values and ways of working.

We are thorough in our hiring process, as it's essential to us that we select new Tactilers carefully - just as it is vital to ensure that we are the right place for you.

We want to ensure you have a great candidate experience whilst in our recruitment process. We will do everything within reason to ensure that your interview takes place in an environment that fairly and accurately assesses your skills. If you need assistance or accommodation, please let us know.

We look forward to receiving your application! 👋

jobs.occupation: Senior ML Data Engineer
jobs.description:
**About GoWish, Ønskeskyen ☁️

**At GoWish, we’re building the world’s leading wish-list and social shopping platform - a place where you can make a real impact and have fun doing it.

We’re on a mission to reinvent gifting for millions. We win together, driven by curiosity, ownership, and bold ideas that turn into real products. We experiment cross-functionally, push for excellence, and keep things playful as we grow - together.

**Team & Role Overview

**We are looking for a systems-minded Senior ML Data Engineer to own the offline-to-online feature infrastructure that powers our real-time recommendation and search engines at scale. You will be building the low-latency data syncs and feature-serving layers that bridge our analytical warehouses with operational databases, caches, and Feature Stores. This is a role for a performance-driven engineer who excels at pipeline orchestration (Airflow, dbt), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Docker), and database tuning, ensuring our recommendation systems receive reliable data under strict low-latency SLAs. If you thrive on solving complex data synchronization challenges, scaling operational storage for millions of users, and acting as the operational bridge between Data Science and Backend Engineering - you will play a critical role in powering our product's core ML capabilities.

**What You'll Do

**

• Offline-to-Online Feature Pipelines: Build and operate resilient feature pipelines syncing transformed data from analytical warehouses (e.g., BigQuery) into operational storage layers (e.g., AlloyDB, Redis, Feature Stores) to serve real-time ML recommendation models at scale.

• Pipeline Orchestration and Transformations: Design, test, and maintain robust Apache Airflow DAGs and modular dbt transformations to automate end-to-end data ingestion and feature generation under strict low-latency SLAs.

• Infrastructure as Code and Reliability: Provision, scale, and automate cloud data infrastructure using Terraform, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines, implementing automated data quality testing and monitoring across all feature syncs.

• Cross-Functional System Design: Partner directly with Data Scientists and Backend Engineers to define online/offline feature contracts, optimize database schemas for sub-second queries, and eliminate training-serving skew for millions of active users.

**What we’re looking for 🌟

****We Imagine That You Have

**

• 4+ years of experience

• Operational Data Pipelines: Proven experience moving batch features from analytical warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake) into low-latency online stores (AlloyDB, Redis, Feature Stores) to serve real-time ML recommendation models.

• Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Deep hands-on experience provisioning, scaling, and managing cloud data infrastructure using Terraform, Docker, and modern CI/CD automation pipelines.

• Pipeline Orchestration & Transformations: Strong track record building, scheduling, and maintaining workflow orchestrations (e.g., Airflow, Dagster) and modular data transformation frameworks (e.g., dbt).

• Database Performance Tuning: Advanced SQL skills across both OLAP and OLTP systems. Ability to optimize schemas, indexing, partitioning, and queries.

It is further seen as an advantage to have experience with:

• Production Feature Management: Experience managing Feature Stores (e.g., Feast, Tecton) or low-latency key-value stores (e.g., Redis) to serve online ML features with zero training-serving skew.

• Real-Time OLA): Experience with ClickHouse, Pinot, Druid or others for ultra-fast aggregations over live event streams.

• Event Streaming: Hands-on experience with streaming tools like GCP Pub/Sub, Kafka, or Flink for real-time feature updates.

Why GoWish should sit at top of your career wish list 💙

At GoWish, we believe great work comes from people who feel energized, supported, and excited to show up every day. That’s why we’ve built a workplace where celebration, growth, and genuine enjoyment are part of the journey - not perks on the side.

Take your birthday off with Happy Birthday Leave, enjoy 30 days of vacation to fully recharge, and join a team that fills the year with events and playful happenings. We invest in your future with pension and insurance, fuel your days with a weekly lunch scheme, and keep you going with unlimited snacks and sodas - because work should feel good.

At GoWish, you don’t just build great products. You build a great work life.

**Practical information

**We collaborate in a flexible hybrid setup, with most of our magic happening at our bright, modern office in Østerbro - perfectly placed between Nordhavn and Østerport Station. We’re ready for you to join us as soon as you are.

👉 Ready to help shape a platform that already empowers 18+ million users (and counting)? Join us at GoWish - and let’s build the future of data-driven innovation together.

Don’t wait to apply - we review applications continuously and may close the position once the right candidate is found.

jobs.occupation: PhD position at the Center for Polariton-driven Light-Matter Interactions (POLIMA)
jobs.description:
The Center for Polariton-driven Light-Matter Interactions (POLIMA) at The Mads Clausen Institute, University of Southern Denmark, is seeking a talented and highly motivated PhD student to work on the development of new theoretical frameworks for describing light–matter interactions in advanced van der Walls heterostructures probed by polaritons generated through inelastic tunneling. The position is funded by a Villum Young Investigator grant awarded to Assistant Professor P. André D. Gonçalves, who will supervise the PhD research.

The position is available starting 1 March 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

The successful candidate will develop new theoretical frameworks and computational methods to investigate the fundamental limits of polariton-mediated inelastic electron tunneling in tunnel junctions based on van der Waals heterostructures composed of atomically thin materials. The project will employ a broad range of analytical, semi-analytical, and numerical techniques to explore electrically driven polaritonic phenomena. A major focus will be on harnessing polariton-mediated inelastic electron tunneling as a tool to probe and manipulate light–matter interactions at the nanoscale, as well as to characterize the optoelectronic response of complex quantum materials.

We welcome candidates with a strong background in condensed-matter physics and/or quantum nanophotonics who are highly motivated and eager to pursue world-class research in theoretical quantum nano-optoelectronics. Experience with scientific programming is expected, while familiarity with numerical techniques is advantageous but not required. The ideal candidate will be enthusiastic about contributing to cutting-edge research in a dynamic and ambitious young research group, supported by the POLIMA Center and its extensive network of international collaborators.

POLIMA is a Center of Excellence funded by the Danish National Research Foundation (DNRF) for an initial period of 6 years (2023–2028), with the possibility of a 4-year extension. The center is led by Professor N. Asger Mortensen and currently consists of two Professors, three Assistant Professors, a Lab Manager, a Center Administrator, and approximately 10–15 PhD students, postdocs, and visiting scientists. Several POLIMA researchers have attracted prestigious personal grants, e.g., Villum Investigator, Villum Young Investigator, DFF Sapere Aude, Novo Nordisk’s Foundation RECRUIT and Data Science Investigator – Emerging, and Maria Skłodowska-Curie Fellowships. Read more on POLIMA’s website.

We offer a competitive and highly collaborative research environment with close interaction between experimental and theoretical activities. You will join a thriving community of researchers and benefit from a strong network of international collaborators. Our work environment is supportive, dynamic, and designed to foster creativity and the development of innovative projects.

 

We offer:

• A PhD student position in an ambitious and supportive, international research environment.

• A dedicated supervisor research team to support the academic development of the PhD student.

• Access to state-of-the-art equipment, facilities, and infrastructure.

• A competitive salary and social benefits (e.g., health coverage, parental leave, social security, etc.) (https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/international-staff/getting-settled)

POLIMA is located at the University of Southern Denmark in Odense – 1h15min by train from Copenhagen Airport. The University of Southern Denmark offers dedicated assistance and support with various practical, social, and legal aspects (housing, visa, administration, tax, etc.), especially for international candidates through our international staff office (ISO) and the administrative staff at POLIMA.

 

For further information and details about the position, application, and the research center, please contact Assistant Professor Paulo André Dias Gonçalves (padgo@mci.sdu.dk).

If you experience technical problems, please contact hcm-support@sdu.dk. 

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and an application must include: 

• 
Motivated application. 

• 
Curriculum Vitae.

• 
Master’s and bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (copy of original and an official English translation).  

• 
Completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

• 
Completed TEK PhD form for calculation grade point average. Find the form at the Faculty website. 

• 
An official document describing the grading scheme of the awarding universities (if not Danish). 

• 
Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

• 
List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications (in case you have any publications).

• 
References may be included, you're welcome to use the form for reference letter at the Faculty website.

• 
A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is 31 December, 2026, at 11:59 PM / 23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU. Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process. 

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.075 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step.

The preferred start date is 1 March 2026 (may be adjusted by mutual agreement) or as soon as possible thereafter. 

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

jobs.occupation: Operations & Growth Manager
jobs.employer_name: BTR Personnel services AB, filial af BTR Personnel services AB, Sverige
jobs.description:
We are looking for an Operations & Growth Manager to join our team and play an important role in the next stage of our growth. We are looking for someone who wants to understand how a growing consumer brand works from the inside and become involved across multiple areas of the business—from operations and retail to marketing, business development, data, systems, and growth.

The Role

As Operations & Growth Manager, you will help manage the day-to-day execution of the business while also working on projects that contribute directly to the company’s growth.

Your responsibilities will span five main areas:

·       Operations & Execution — approximately 30%

·       New Business Development — approximately 20%

·       Marketing & Brand Growth — approximately 20%

·       Business Intelligence & Analysis — approximately 20%

·       Processes, Systems & Automation — approximately 10%

The exact balance may evolve as the company grows. This is a role for someone who is comfortable switching between execution and strategy. 

What You'll Work On:

Operations & Retail Execution

You will help make sure the operational side runs accurately and efficiently.

This may include:

·       Managing and tracking purchase orders.

·       Monitoring inventory levels and availability.

·       Coordinating retailer orders.

·       Communicating with warehouses and logistics partners.

·       Following shipments and resolving delivery issues.

·       Managing Amazon inventory and operational requirements.

·       Supporting retailer compliance.

·       Coordinating invoices and documentation.

·       Communicating with customers, suppliers, retailers, warehouses, and external partners.

·       Identifying potential inventory shortages before they become problems.

·       Making sure deadlines and retailer requirements are met.

·       Improving operational accuracy.

·       Helping reduce preventable errors.

·       Creating better visibility into what is happening across the business.

 

Business Development & Retail Growth

You will also help identify and develop new commercial opportunities.

This may include:

·       Researching prospective retailers.

·       Identifying distributors and brokers.

·       Finding potential strategic partners.

·       Building lists of prospective accounts.

·       Conducting initial outreach.

·       Following up with prospective customers.

·       Preparing presentations and sales materials.

·       Coordinating product samples.

·       Preparing pricing and product information.

·        Supporting negotiations.

·       Helping onboard new accounts.

·       Researching new retail channels.

·       Identifying geographic expansion opportunities.

·       Helping grow relationships with existing accounts.

 

Marketing & Brand Growth

You will participate in initiatives designed to increase awareness, trial, engagement, and repeat purchase.

Projects may include:

·       Influencer partnerships.

·       Creator collaborations.

·       Social media initiatives.

·       Retail marketing programs.

·       Product sampling.

·       In-store activations.

·       Tastings.

·       Amazon marketing.

·       Brand partnerships.

·       Promotional campaigns.

·       LinkedIn and social content planning.

·       Retailer-specific marketing programs.

·       Coordinating marketing assets.

·       Tracking campaign results.

·       Identifying new ways to introduce consumers.

 

Business Intelligence & Analytics

As we grow, data will become increasingly important to how we make decisions. You will help organize information and transform it into useful insights.

This may include:

·       Building dashboards.

·       Tracking sales performance.

·       Analyzing inventory.

·       Reviewing Amazon performance.

·       Monitoring retail sell-through.

·       Comparing retailer performance.

·       Tracking marketing results.

·       Identifying patterns and trends.

·       Detecting potential risks.

·       Finding opportunities hidden in the data.

·       Preparing reports for company leadership.

·       Turning information into actionable recommendations.

Systems, Processes & Automation

We are building for the next stage of growth. That means improving not only what we do, but how we do it. You will help us create systems that make the business easier to operate and scale.

Projects may include:

·       Creating Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

·       Documenting recurring processes.

·       Building internal templates.

·       Improving information organization.

·       Identifying repetitive manual work.

·       Finding opportunities for automation.

·       Implementing AI tools where useful.

·       Creating dashboards and internal tools.

·       Developing processes that can eventually be delegated.

·       Helping create more scalable operating systems.

 

Preferred Background 

·       A strong candidate may have experience or education in areas such as:

·       Business Administration

·       International Business

·       Operations

·       Supply Chain

·       Marketing

·       Business Development

·       Retail

·       Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG)

·       E-commerce

·       Entrepreneurship

·       Analytics

 

Experience working with food, retail, Amazon, consumer products, logistics, distributors, brokers, or growing companies is a plus. Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills are highly valuable. Experience with tools such as Amazon Seller Central, Notion, Canva, CRM platforms, dashboards, AI tools, or automation platforms is also a plus.

English is required. Spanish is highly valuable.

jobs.occupation: Senior Operational Technology (OT) Security Officer, flere lokationer | Ørsted
jobs.description:
Imagine a future where you'll protect the ability to supply electricity and heat to the end user and make sure that our critical OT systems are protected against hackers

We offer a workplace culture where you’ll be working from the office every work day.

Join us in this role where you’ll be working as a Senior Operational Technology (OT) Security Officer to strengthen the security, resilience, and compliance of Ørsted Bioenergy. In this role, you will act as a trusted security lead across OT, IT, engineering, and operations, helping protect critical systems while enabling safe, reliable, and efficient operations. Further more we are partnering with operations, engineering, maintenance, IT, and third-party vendors to ensure security controls are practical, risk-based, and compatible with operational safety and availability – and we “translate” technical cyber risk into clear business, safety, and operational impact requirements. We operate in complex, multi-site, international, or safety-critical operational environments.

**Welcome to Bioenergy

**You’ll be part of OT Security where you, together with your colleagues, will be working on Ørsted Danish powerplant. Our task is to protect the powerplants ability to produce electricity and heat against hacker attacks. So you need to understand Danish, when you’re out on the powerplants. We are a small team of 4 persons located in Jutland (Jylland) who works together and strive in helping each other in our daily tasks. As a team, we have an open and direct commutation where we discuss ideas strategy and ideas to develop and mature our solutions, so they are robust and they deal with the reality we face.

You’ll play an important role in:

• leading the development and continuous improvement of OT security governance, policies, standards, and procedures

• assessing, managing, and reducing cyber risk across OT environments, including industrial control systems, SCADA, PLCs, IIoT, and related networks

• defining and supporting secure OT architecture, including network segmentation, secure remote access, asset visibility, access control, logging, monitoring, and vulnerability management

• conducting OT security risk assessments, gap analyses, and maturity reviews aligned with recognised frameworks e.g. Danish legislation “Lov om styrket Beredskab i Energisektoren”, IEC 62443, ISO 27001 and relevant regulatory requirements

• partnering with operations, engineering, maintenance, IT, and third-party vendors to ensure security controls are practical, risk-based, and compatible with operational safety and availability requirements

• driving OT security awareness and training for technical and operational teams.

To succeed in the role, you:

• hold a relevant degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Technology, Automation, or equivalent practical experience

• understand and know how to operate in ICS systems and possess understanding of 24/7 production environment

• are familiar with IT networks like, Purdue model, firewall, data diodes etc.

• hold knowledge about EIC 62433, ISO 27001 and "Lov om styrket Beredskab i Energisektoren" as we operate according to this legislation

• are a good team player and at the same are strong on being responsible of incl. conducting your own tasks – you need to be fluent in both Danish and English language as well due to nature our stake holder landscape

• are flexible - both in terms of taking on tasks outside your comfortzone, being curious in learning new areas and assist your team in whatever tasks are needed.

Some travel within Denmark to the different sites must be expected in the this role.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

**Shape the future with us

**Send your application and CV to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

Position salary range: For this position, the expected base pay range is kr55,040.00- kr82,560.00 for the advertised location. The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package.

**Our benefits package:

**For this position, employees who meet eligibility requirements have access to: employer‑paid pension (11 % contribution), full insurance coverage (accident, life, critical illness, and health insurance); five weeks of paid holiday plus 10 additional paid days off per holiday year; a 3 % holiday allowance; access to Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality including fitness classes, physiotherapy, massage, and well-being programmes; a multimedia package (mobile phone, PC, and internet); staff club membership with sport and cultural activities; and access to the company canteen (monthly lunch scheme or daily tickets).

**Pre-employment background check:

**This position requires a background check as part of the hiring process and the offer is dependent on the outcome of this check. You will receive more information during the recruitment process. Background checks are conducted by an external provider in accordance with local legal requirements.
